title: Chilworth Gunpowder Family Trail
description:
Join us at the village hall for a fun-filled family afternoon!

There’ll be plenty to keep the children entertained, including a fun trail around the village, along with hot drinks and homemade cakes for everyone to enjoy.

We’ll also have an exhibition of previously unseen photographs of the Gunpowder Mills, dating back to 1864.

Relax with a cup of tea and a slice of cake, and join us at 4.30 pm for a short talk about these wonderful photographs.

We look forward to seeing you there!
